title: Multi-label and Multi-target Sampling of Machine Annotation for Computational Stance Detection
benchmark_measurement: Stance detection towards the concept of atheism and related terms like 'religion' or 'belief in god'.
findings: Large Language Models' performance in stance detection is highly sensitive to how a faith-related target is described. For instance, models performed significantly better on the target 'religion' than on the target 'atheism', even when labels were logically reversed, indicating that the specific terminology used to represent a belief system impacts prediction accuracy.
